title: Forrestal's trips to Paris with questions

tellings.quote: I found several references to Portol for him going to Paris with questions and getting answers.

plain: James Forrestal, a senior American defence official of the 1940s, travelled to Paris with questions and came back with answers. A former presidential adviser named Harold Malmgren tells Michels he found several references to these trips, but he does not say where he found them, what the questions were, or who answered them in Paris.
